scope: Six source-first incident reviews of new taxonomy FC086 Relational Boundary Fidelity and FC087 Vulnerability-Responsive Protection Fidelity
policy_boundary: Admit failure only with required class evidence; preserve pleading posture, contemporaneous protective duty and output visibility; no automatic control activation claim.
